bottleneck.evidence: Dashboard has 18 commercial leads in the calling hub, Easter sprint kit with social copy, 3 undeployed video ads, and a full contact script library. There is ZERO mechanism to track whether TJ is actually making the calls. The commercial calling hub lists priorities and scripts — but we have no data on: (1) how many calls/texts TJ sent today, (2) which leads converted to consultations, (3) which content is actually getting posted. We're optimizing content production while flying blind on execution. At 11/25 customers, the gap is closed by execution, not more content.
bottleneck.recommendation: Install a daily execution check. A simple 5 PM cron that asks TJ: 'How many calls/texts did you make today? Any appointments set?' — log the answer in a daily tally. This surfaces the real constraint (execution rate) vs the vanity proxy (content created).

compoundingImprovement.suggestion: Daily Execution Scorecard — 5 PM cron asks TJ 3 questions: (1) Calls/texts made today? (2) Appointments set? (3) Any new customers signed? Answers logged to a tally file. Chief reviews weekly. This creates the feedback loop that converts our content library into measurable pipeline data. One cron job, permanent compound visibility into what's actually converting.
compoundingImprovement.effort: Low — 20 min to set up cron + tally file
compoundingImprovement.compoundingMechanism: Every day of tracking compounds into weekly/monthly conversion data. After 4 weeks we know: which scripts get callbacks, which content drives inbound texts, what days TJ calls most. Turns guesswork into a repeatable system.
compoundingImprovement.priority: HIGH — without this, we're optimizing content while flying blind on what converts
